comparison_metadata.comparison_title: Drug-OPT Prediction Engine v3.3.3 Candidate vs v3.3.2 Production Baseline Comparison

pka.model_type: Rule-Based Substructure Matching (Macro/Micro Acid & Base Split)
pka.validation_summary: 19 reference drug pairs evaluated: All MAE = 1.083, Acidic MAE = 0.480, Basic MAE = 1.434
pka.rationale: External ML candidates showed reproducibility and PyG dependency failures on ARM64. Retained robust rule engine.

logd_7_4.validation_summary: 20 reference drug pairs evaluated: MAE = 0.873, RMSE = 1.125, Bias = -0.351
logd_7_4.rationale: Direct statistical ML model unavailable; HH thermodynamic derivation mathematically rigorous but lacks independent ML holdout.

vdss.model_type: Mechanistic Consensus (Retained v3.3 Tissue Composition & Ionization)
vdss.validation_summary: 18 human clinical IV observations evaluated: Log10 MAE = 0.474, AAFE = 2.98-fold, 55.6% within 2-fold band
vdss.rationale: Holdout error reduction vs base did not meet >=5% requirement for Level 4 promotion.

fu_ppb.guardrail: Physical lower bound of 0.0001 prevents division by zero and astronomical clearance artifacts.

clearance_ivive.guardrail: Extraction ratio strictly in [0.0, 1.0) and blood clearance strictly bounded by Qh.

simulation.uncertainty: Monte Carlo 1,000 draws generating 90% confidence intervals (5th, 50th, 95th percentiles).

drugbank_expansion_summary.collision_check: 100% collision-free across Name, DrugBank ID, CAS, UNII, PubChem CID, InChIKey
drugbank_expansion_summary.database_integrity: 0 FK violations, 0 orphans, all 250 compounds hydrated with valid 2D SVGs

governance_decision.recommendation: Maintain v3.3.2 as production default for live user predictions; activate v3.3.3 candidate evaluation in Help and Model History registries.
